reviewStandard: Only exact neutral quercetin is cleared for one immutable call. The other five routes fail strain, formulation, stereoisomer, source-resolution, evidence, protocol, population, measurement, safety, or canonical-media-ownership gates and receive no prompt marker or generation call.
promotionRule: Only a literal single-model output matching the frozen neutral-quercetin 15-carbon, 7-oxygen, 22-heavy-atom connectivity, opaque pale field, prohibited-content, and crop-safe requirements may proceed to exact-hash review. The other five routes remain non-public scientific holds.

routeDecisions.reason: The broad route and its sources do not select cis- or trans-resveratrol, while the current MeSH descriptor explicitly contains both narrower stereoisomers; one model would silently narrow the subject and two would imply both were represented in the interventions.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Reconcile every relevant source to cis, trans, unspecified, mixture, metabolite, or formulation; then select the canonical chemical identity, charge and stereochemistry, formulation, dose, population, comparator, assay, endpoint, and visual class policy.
